name: f16-pio
$comment: Pilot-induced oscillation: an aggressive pilot (gain, 0.25 s delay) captures a 7 deg pitch change through a rate-limited stabilator, with a plain rate limit and with a phase-compensated one. Generated by design/build_model.py.

annotations.text: Pilot: stick = clamp(K/40 (theta_target - theta(t - 0.25 s)), +-1); K in 1/s.

**Airframe.** RigidBody3D on its principal axes (the book's Jxz tilts them 1.05 deg from the body x axis); the wrench is applied in the geometric body frame through the Mount (FixedTransform3DNeutral).
Elevator servo: 20.2 rad/s lag, +-25 deg, +-60 deg/s (Stevens & Lewis).
Pilot: stick = clamp(K/40 (theta_target - theta(t - 0.25 s)), +-1); K in 1/s.

**Airframe.** RigidBody3D on its principal axes (the book's Jxz tilts them 1.05 deg from the body x axis); the wrench is applied in the geometric body frame through the Mount (FixedTransform3DNeutral).
Phase-compensated rate limiter: y' = clamp(du/dt + k (u - y), +-60 deg/s).
Elevator servo: 20.2 rad/s lag, +-25 deg, +-60 deg/s (Stevens & Lewis).

plots.title: Angle of attack (deg) and load factor (g)

parameters.name: pilot_gain
parameters.description: Pilot gain: pitch rate asked per degree of attitude error

parameters.name: pio_amp
parameters.description: Attitude change the pilot is asked to capture (deg)

parameters.name: comp_k
parameters.description: Pull-back gain of the phase-compensated rate limiter

options.text: An aggressive pilot captures a pitch-attitude change. **Plain**: the stabilator hits its 60 deg/s rate limit and the loop oscillates. **Comp**: the phase-compensated rate limiter removes the lag and the oscillation dies out.
